name: Golden Triangle Tour India: Delhi, Agra, Jaipur Tour
overview: The Golden Triangle Tours India is one of the most sought-after travel circuits, connecting Delhi, Agra, and Jaipur. This tour offers travelers an unparalleled opportunity to experience India’s rich culture, majestic architecture, and fascinating history. Perfect for first-time visitors, it is a well-balanced mix of exploration and comfort, making it an unforgettable journey. Explore the Highlights of Golden Triangle Tours India The Golden Triangle Tour India brings together three iconic cities, each unique in its charm. Delhi: A bustling metropolis where ancient history meets urban vibrance. Agra: The land of the world-famous Taj Mahal, a symbol of eternal love. Jaipur: The Pink City, renowned for its royal palaces, forts, and colorful markets. Delhi: The Perfect Blend of History and Modernity Start your journey in Delhi, India’s dynamic capital city that reflects a harmonious blend of its rich past and modern advancements. Visit the awe-inspiring Qutub Minar and Humayun’s Tomb, both UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Explore the chaotic yet charming lanes of Chandni Chowk, packed with iconic eateries and vibrant bazaars. Pay homage at the serene Lotus Temple and marvel at the grandeur of India Gate. Witness the legacy of the Mughal era at Red Fort and feel the pulse of modern India at Connaught Place. Agra: Experience the Timeless Beauty of the Taj Mahal Agra is a treasure trove of Mughal architecture and culture. It is home to the iconic Taj Mahal, a masterpiece in white marble and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Admire the intricate craftsmanship of the Taj Mahal, a breathtaking monument to love. Discover the splendor of Agra Fort, a majestic fortress with rich historical significance. Explore Fatehpur Sikri, the ghost city that was once the Mughal capital. Immerse yourself in local culture by sampling the famous Agra Petha and shopping for marble souvenirs. Jaipur: Discover the Royal Grandeur of the Pink City The final stop on your Golden Triangle journey is Jaipur, the vibrant capital of Rajasthan , known for its royal heritage and architectural wonders. Wander through the impressive Amber Fort, perched on a hilltop and offering stunning views. Snap photos at the iconic Hawa Mahal, also known as the Palace of Winds. Discover the regal charm of the City Palace, a blend of Rajasthani and Mughal architecture. Visit the astronomical marvel of Jantar Mantar, another UNESCO World Heritage Site. Don’t miss the local markets, famous for their exquisite jewelry, textiles, and handicrafts. Why Choose Golden Triangle Tours India for Your Next Adventure? Covers the most iconic destinations of India in one compact itinerary. Perfect for history buffs, architecture enthusiasts, and culture seekers. Available in customizable packages to suit different preferences and budgets. Offers a deep dive into India’s diverse traditions, cuisines, and heritage. Customized Golden Triangle Tour Packages for Every Traveler Whether you’re traveling solo, as a couple, or with family, Golden Triangle Tours India offers packages tailored to your needs. Choose from luxury options, budget-friendly tours, or specialized itineraries that include additional destinations like Varanasi or Ranthambore for a tiger safari adventure. Embark on the Golden Triangle Tour India to witness the essence of India’s history, culture, and magnificence. Book now to create memories that will last a lifetime!

name: Shekhawati tour with golden triangle
overview: India is not just about the Golden Triangle, our Shekhawati tour with golden triangle captures the essence of India in the three cities of Delhi, Agra, and Jaipur which houses the world-famous monument Taj Mahal, the Qutub Minar, and the Lotus Temple, UNESCO site Amber Fort . These cities are a must-visit on your first tour of India and besides the famed Golden Triangle circuit explore the majestic haveli’s in the small towns of the Shekhawat region. Explore the ways of living in the rural and smaller places which give you a deep insight into the lifestyle of 70% of the population of the country which still is not connected to metros and cities. Shekhawati is a region covering nearly three districts of Rajasthan, it was named after Rao Sheikha who once ruled the region and later followed by his Generations. Legend has it that Rao Shekha was born by the blessing of a Sufi saint and in honor, he was named Shekha, and his descendants were called Shekhawat. The region has a number of small forts some of which are converted into hotels, and the most interesting piece is the Shekhawati Haveli’s studded by fresco paintings depicting the scenes of Ramayana- Mahabharata the ancients texts of India to figures of god and goddesses, and also the nobilities of the rulers, to the latest English armies along with describing the general living of the people in the region. These haveli’s of Shekhawati give a brief about India’s past present up to the 20th century in the form of paintings on the walls of these beautiful Haveli’s. The Shekhawati Haveli’s were built by the rich merchants of the region who went out to work and when they earned enough came back and made these grand mansions for their families who they left behind. Along with the Haveli’s the region gives a glimpse of the rural or semi-urban town. Immerse in the colors of India in this beautiful region. Learn about our Shekhawati tour with golden triangle from traveler reviews . name: Indian Saga
overview: Indian Saga takes you through bustling capital of India with a fascinating history, home to nearly 19 million people from all parts of the nation. Catch the glimpse of the Taj Mahal changing colors with the rising sun and experience the rich history, cuisines, and culture of the city which attracts visitors from across the globe. Experience life in an Indian village and walk among the dusty streets exchanging smiles with the locals. Continue to the regal state of Rajasthan which is home to beautiful palaces and forts along with them the old hunting grounds of the Jaipur royals which are now transformed into a wildlife reserve for the conservation of the endangered species the Royal Bengal Tigers which are only found in India, the park at the moment has more than 60 tigers in an open environment. These grounds once belonged to the royal family of Jaipur and here the prince and kings used to visit for hunting tigers which was the main cause of depletion of these magnificent cats. UNESCO World Heritage city of Jaipur has a lot to offer from the maintained City palace which has beautiful painting and decorations and armory then to the Amber Fort and the famous Monkey Temple. Varanasi, a city of more than a thousand temples and shrines and sacred to Hindus and Buddhists alike this city has been a cultural and religious center in North India for several thousand years and one of the oldest continuously inhabited city. As Mark Twain said, “Benares is older than history, older than tradition, older even than legend, and look twice as old as all them put together.” Indulge in the experiencing of aarti ceremony – a Hindu religious ritual of worship in which oil lamps are offered to one or more deities – on the banks of Ganges at sunrise and sunset listening to the saga of saints and Sadhus. name: Thar desert tour
overview: Explore the best of western Rajasthan on our Thar desert Tour, situated on the west the Thar desert cover mainly the districts of Jodhpur, Jaisalmer, and Bikaner which lies to the east of the Aravali mountain ranges which prevents the rainfall from reaching the region. Living amid the western part of Rajasthan was hard in the earlier times, with low agricultural productivity and only a few vegetation grown Thar desert provided rough-tough conditioning to make a living. The great rulers of these former princely states have survived themselves and even made their great contributions to transform these states by constructing grand lakes to maintain a year-long water supply, incredible palaces, and forts, and other architectural marvels thus bringing life to these far off regions. The sand dunes are a perfect place to stay at night among the desert and enjoy a camel ride cause camels are the ship of the deserts and were tamed and trained for transportation of men and goods through the deserted regions. Bikaner’s Junagarh Fort has a rare collection of weapons and things from the past at display which makes it worth visiting. Almost 30Km from Bikaner is the most bizarre place in the world – Rat Temple India. Visit Jodhpur’s Mehrangarh fort made with fine carvings and situated atop a hill with long walls to prevent enemy attacks on your Thar desert tour. The magnificent blue colored city is visible to the west of the fort, these blue homes houses the people working in the fort and are blue to escape the scorching heat. Don’t miss the incredible marble cenotaphs Jaswant Thada nearby on your western Rajasthan Tour. Jaisalmer is the extreme western part of rajasthan. This rigid desert city was confined to the premises of the Golden fort in earlier times, the fort is golden in color and camouflage with the sands. The Gadi Sagar lake built in to supply water to the people is like a heaven for the city. overview: Taj Mahal India Tours: Explore the Timeless Beauty of India’s Famous Landmark The Taj Mahal , one of the Seven Wonders of the World, is a breathtaking symbol of love, grandeur, and architectural brilliance. Located in the city of Agra , India, this iconic white marble mausoleum attracts millions of visitors each year. For those seeking to experience the wonder of this majestic monument, Taj Mahal Tour Packages provide the perfect way to explore its beauty and history. Why Visit the Taj Mahal? The Taj Mahal stands as a timeless tribute to love, built by Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan in memory of his beloved wife Mumtaz Mahal. Known for its intricate marble inlay work, beautiful gardens, and stunning architecture, the Taj Mahal is a masterpiece that represents the peak of Mughal art and design. The monument is not only an architectural wonder but also a symbol of eternal love, making it an essential stop for any traveler visiting India. Here are a few reasons why a visit to the Taj Mahal should be on your travel bucket list: Architectural Beauty : The Taj Mahal is a stunning example of Mughal architecture, blending Persian, Ottoman Turkish, and Indian styles. Its symmetry, marble carvings, and intricate detailing leave visitors in awe. Cultural Significance : The Taj Mahal is a UNESCO World Heritage site and is one of the most recognizable structures in the world. A visit here offers a glimpse into India’s rich history and royal heritage. Romantic Experience : Known as a symbol of eternal love, the Taj Mahal provides a romantic atmosphere, making it a favorite destination for honeymooners and couples. Here’s what you can expect: Guided Tour of the Taj Mahal Every Taj Mahal India Tour package includes a guided tour of the Taj Mahal, where our expert guides will share the fascinating history and stories behind the monument. Learn about the love story of Shah Jahan and Mumtaz Mahal, the construction of the Taj, and the intricate architectural details that make it a masterpiece. Visit to Agra Fort Most of our Agra Tour Packages include a visit to Agra Fort, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Located just a few kilometers from the Taj Mahal, Agra Fort was once the residence of the Mughal emperors. It offers panoramic views of the Taj Mahal from its ramparts and provides a glimpse into the royal lifestyle of the Mughal era. Sunset View from Mehtab Bagh For a truly unforgettable experience, our packages often include a visit to Mehtab Bagh, a garden located across the Yamuna River from the Taj Mahal. Itmad-ud-Daula’s Tomb : Often referred to as the “Baby Taj,” this beautiful tomb is an architectural gem and a precursor to the Taj Mahal’s design. name: India Festival expedition | Holidays 2024-25 India Tours
overview: Since the major festival of Diwali arrives as per the movement of the stars and the sun, be sure to select your dates appropriately to blend in the joyous atmosphere spread across India on our Indian festival Expedition. The festival of light is celebrated on the occasion of the homecoming of Lord Ram with his wife Sita who was abducted by Ravan the then ruler of Sri Lanka. Diwali is celebrated throughout the country and one should get a mask beforehand as the smoke from the fireworks and crackers can sometimes get thick, especially in cities. Carry your fancy outfits or you can buy one from the local markets, to blend in the colors of Diwali, as most people wear their shiny and fancy clothes including Poshaks filling the streets with colors. Get your work done and bags packed before it’s late. Our India festival expedition is fully customizable and the itinerary is prepared on request. Across India Diwali is celebrated with joy, homes illuminated with lights and oil lamps locally known as diyas, with people visiting their friends and relatives, it is the time of the year when you go and greet your family and friends. We take you across the cities and the rural region to have a first-hand experience of the India Holi festival and the Festival of lights. Choose your destination in India, be it Udaipur the city of lakes in India , or the pink city of Jaipur, these cities are a perfect choice to celebrate the festival with your loved ones. With our experts on tour who will share with you the local customs and traditions, and take you to the right places for celebrations. Indulge in a celebration unlike any other, filled with lights, sweets and warmth as you move through the celebration week across India.
highlights: Feel the color of India in the festive season. The brightly lit street filled with women's shopping for the auspicious ocasion's. Indulge in the celebration. Do it the Indian way.
